governance_status.prepilot_result_note: Progression: round 1 ended INCONCLUSIVE because minimum sample thresholds were unmet (17 events < 20, 7 queries < 10) and the initially used verdict string was not a member of the frozen result enum (see Governance Correction Note in AHRP_PREPILOT_REPORT_v0.1.md, preserved). Phase 2 completed 2026-08-04 with all minimum sample thresholds met (46 tasks, 31 events, 23 queries, 10 shadow comparisons, 3 EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED_DECISION_CHANGEs, 28 independent verifications, 8 FAILURE/TIMEOUT/CANCELLED events), so PREPILOT_RESULT advances to SUPPORTED_WITH_CONDITIONS. The formal-pilot conditions (real agents, networked query service, two-phase shadow protocol, no-AHRP baseline arm, real verifier pool, trusted time anchoring, non-synthetic long-term data, real operational accountability, external adoption evidence) remain unresolved; this result makes no production, adoption, or reliability claim.
governance_status.governance_correction_history: Governance Correction Note (2026-08-05): round-1 verdict string SUPPORTED_FOR_PILOT_WITH_CONDITIONS retracted as not a member of the frozen enum; status corrected to PREPILOT_RESULT=INCONCLUSIVE with PREPILOT_MINIMUM_SAMPLE_REQUIREMENTS_MET=false. That correction remains part of the record and is not deleted by this update.

api_limitations: frozen v0.1 schemas declare additionalProperties=false: the control block and monotonic_sequence cannot be embedded inside AHRP event/verification records; they are carried on prepilot wrapper records and summarized in the whitelisted notes field

round-1 deterministic synthetic timestamps extend slightly into the future relative to the real phase-2 UTC clock; phase-2 records use real UTC timestamps and are internally time-ordered (verification >= event, query >= referenced phase-2 events, monotonic_sequence 1000..1049 strictly increasing); round-1 records untouched (append-only)
